query:
UPDATE accounts
         SET external_id = $2,
             source_system = 'SALESFORCE',
             name = $3,
             city = $4,
             country = $5,
             industry = $6,
             website = $7,
             employee_count = $8,
             revenue = $9::text::numeric,
             synced_at = COALESCE($10, now()),
             data_hash = $11,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
